rationale: B01 is an aggregate coverage flag. The raw source is readable and shows the current investment schedule has fair value columns populated through the category totals and total investments line: bank debt fair value is 212,742 and total investments fair value is 234,510. A representative preferred equity row also carries a fair value cell. Therefore the 50.0% extracted fair-value coverage is not explained by missing source disclosure; it reflects an extraction/column coverage defect.
